items.text: Who in this group has the best taste in music?
Do an impression of the person on your left until someone guesses who it is.
Who here would you trust with your Netflix password?
Give the person on your right a fake award with a made-up title and a short speech.
Who in this room is most likely to be late to their own wedding?
Let the group pick a celebrity for you to imitate for one minute.
Who here has the best laugh?
Give the person on your left three honest compliments, one at a time.
What was your first impression of the person sitting next to you?
Let the group make up a title for you that you must use for the rest of the night.
Who would make the best reality show villain in this group?
Give a two-minute TED-style talk about your most underrated skill.
Who here is the worst at keeping a secret?
Do an impression of your own morning routine as if you were a sitcom character.
What is a funny thing you noticed about someone here that they do not know you noticed?
Choose one player and be their hype man for the next round.
Who in this room would you pick as a travel companion for a month?
Recreate the most awkward moment of tonight so far, with the group as the audience.
What is one thing you admire about the person on your left?
Sing the chorus of a song the person on your right loves.
Who here has the best secret talent?
Make a fake confessional about someone in the room, kind and funny only.
Who in this group would make the best boss?
Teach the group a secret handshake you invent right now.
If this group had a theme song, what would it be?
Read the mood of the room out loud as a weather report.
What is the nicest thing you have ever said about someone here behind their back?
Interview the person on your left about their life goals, like a talk show host.
What is a habit one of your friends has that drives you mad?
Give the funniest 15-second pitch you can for why the person across from you should be Snack Champion.
Who in this group texts the most?
Re-enact a famous movie scene, with two players as the leads.
Who would you ask for relationship advice in this group?
Pretend to be a game show host introducing the next player.
Who in this room would be best in a crisis?
Let the group vote on your worst dance move, then perform it for ten seconds.
Who here is most likely to start a dance-off?
Freeze mid-sentence like a dramatic film character, then resume the sentence.
What is the most ridiculous thing a friend has done to impress you?
Give your best sales pitch for a broom.
Who here has the most unexpected hidden hobby?
Do an impression of a kind podcast host for thirty seconds.
What is a nickname you secretly call one of your friends?
Describe the decor of this room like a museum guide for thirty seconds.
Who would you pick to plan a surprise party, and why?
Speak with the energy of a sports coach for the next round.
What is a crush you once had on someone you were friends with?
Do an impression of the most competitive person in the group, keeping it friendly.
Who here would be the best karaoke singer?
Invent a dance move and name it after the person across from you.
Who in this group would you call first if you got stuck in a lift?
Pretend to be a waiter and describe a dish you invent in great detail.
What is the most talked-about topic in your friend group right now?
Make your funniest face and hold it while the group votes on it.
Who here has the best sense of style?
Stand up and give a dramatic toast to the snacks on the table.
What is the best I-told-you-so you have ever said?
Give a silly one-line review of tonight's party, like a food critic.
Who here would be the most nervous to be the next DJ?
Pretend to be a nature documentary narrator describing the group's next move.
